definitions.text: Four and one added; one more than four. Five nations (Ethnol.), a confederacy of the Huron-Iroquois Indians, consisting of five tribes: Mohawks, Onondagas, Cayugas, Oneidas, and Senecas. They inhabited the region which is now the State of new York.
The number next greater than four, and less than six; five units or objects. Five of them were wise, and five were foolish. Matt. xxv. 2.
A symbol representing this number, as 5, or V.
A starfish with five rays, esp. Asterias rubens.
In fives; consisting of five in one; five repeated; quintuple.
Having five leaflets, as the Virginia creeper.
A compound or twin crystal consisting of five individuals.
A kind of play with a ball against a wall, resembling tennis; - - so named because three fives, or fifteen, are counted to the game. Smart. Fives court, a place for playing fives.
A disease of the glands under the ear in horses; the vives. Shak.
Five-twenty bonds of the United States (bearing six per cent interest), issued in 1862, '64, and '65, redeemable after five and payable in twenty years.
